item: Close out register and make deposit
Make sure CID/deposit matches for the exact day
Batch credit cards
Put money in safe and count change/change order
Match physical bread count to register count (bread tracking)
Be sure all units are turned off including mop sink
Make sure checklists are completed
Check completion of Lobby Closer and Grill Closer
Lock all doors (front, side, back) and set alarm
Review time cards on Harri
Send catering receipts to DO and add to EZ Cater
Wrap all unneeded meats
Clean top shelf of meat case and place parchment paper
Place all meats back in the meat case
Clean and sanitize scale
Windex outside of meat case
Remove doors and windex inside and out — take extra care
Clean door runner tracks
Final wipe-down of meat case
Make sure meat case is streak-free after close; re-windex if needed
Flip all condiments on front line at 5pm
help: After close only, unless a time is noted.

item: Turn off drop-in at 6pm
Thoroughly clean drop-in and slicer
Remove all items from front line (sub bags, 20lb, cups, etc.)
Thoroughly clean counter (under register, etc.)
Clean all display holders
Windex inside and outside of sneezeguard
Place all items back on front line (sub bags, 20lb, cups, etc.)
Restock (sub bags, 20lb, cups, etc.)
Restock parchment paper, if empty
Windex POS, clean register and receipt printer
Clean and sanitize back counter
Empty trash and rinse inside container (after close)
Manager sign-off
